description: The exact price the booking page charges for one service, or a whole trip (items: one total, paid in full once the driver confirms), the page of the priced service to cite (url; pricesUrl: every price) and a link that opens the booking page filled in (time, guests and bags too). Wine day: option and stops; a day too short for its stops is priced as the one they need (optionRaised). Driver: hours (and stops); with to, a ride there from Beaune or from; returnTrip: the driver waits up to 3 h; returnLater: back later (2 rides). Transfer, a ride from any starting point or place to any other: route (its id, its page slug such as lyon-beaune, or a name such as "Lyon airport"), or from and to; direction from: the way back (Meursault → Paris for a flight), at the same fare; stop: a stop on the way; back: the way back; a ride from or to Paris or Lyon never costs less than its route to Beaune, and from or to paris never comes back the same day. A Mercedes adds its supplement per day of service; over 4 guests, the V-Class (carRaised). resolved: what each name became (an unknown place or route is an error with candidates); alternatives: cheaper products for the same job; availability: with date.

back.description: A ride's way back, instead of returnTrip: wait or later the same day (never from or to paris), day another day (returnDate).

car.description: polestar (included), eclass (4 guests) or vclass (7): the Mercedes on request, a supplement per day of service.

direction.description: A ride: to Beaune or the place (default), or from it: from paris, to village:meursault, direction from is Meursault → Paris (CDG, Orly or the city), at the same fare.

extraHours.description: Wine day; default what its stops need.

from.description: Start of a ride (service transfer, or the driver to one place): a station, an airport (airfields by ICAO code), Paris, Lyon, Geneva, Mâcon-Loché TGV (macon), Chalon-sur-Saône (chalon) or a city beyond Burgundy (reims, epernay, troyes, colmar, strasbourg, besancon, arbois, annecy, chamonix, avignon). A wine day: dijon, a full or long day from Dijon and back there, at its price.

guests.description: 4 in the Polestar 2 or the E-Class, 7 in the V-Class.

items.description: Several services (at most 6), each with the fields above.

lang.description: ar: Arabic notes, data in English.

notes.description: For the driver: estates to visit, child seats…

option.description: Wine day: half 4 h, full 8 h, long 12 h.

returnLater.description: Driver to a place: back later the same day (two rides).

returnTrip.description: Driver to a place: back the same day, the driver waiting. Transfer: a trip back another day.

route.description: A transfer route, by id or page slug (lyon (lyon-beaune), paris (paris-beaune), dijon (dijon-beaune), geneva (geneva-beaune), creusot (le-creusot-tgv-beaune), lfsd (dijon-airport-beaune), lfgj (dole-jura-airport-beaune)) or by name ("Lyon airport", "Dijon-Bourgogne", "Dole"): a transfer to or from Beaune (creusot: Le Creusot TGV; lfsd, lfgj: the airports).

stop.description: A ride's stop on the way (a tasting, a lunch): a place id or name; stopHours 1 to 3, each at the hourly price, plus the detour.

stops.description: Places of a wine day, or of the driver by the hour.

time.description: Pickup (a transfer to Beaune: the arrival).

to.description: A place id or name, or event:<id>; for a ride a starting point too ("Lyon airport", "geneva").

name: quote

enum: in full when the driver confirms

title: Exact price for a trip
